title: The structure sheaf on the big fppf site of a scheme
statement: Fix universes as in [def-weil-size-convention]. For a scheme $S$ [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal C_S=(\mathit{Sch}/S)_{\mathrm{fppf}}$ be its big fppf site [def-pc-fppf-site]. Its structure sheaf $\mathcal O_S^{\mathrm{fppf}}$ is the sheaf of commutative rings assigning to $v:V\to S$ the ring $\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$ of global regular functions. For an $S$-morphism $h:V\to W$, restriction is the canonical pullback $h^*:\Gamma(W,\mathcal O_W)\to\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$. The same structure sheaf regarded as a sheaf of rings is obtained by forgetting commutativity, with the same sections and restrictions.
